verdict.rationale: LegalZoom stores sensitive business documents and ships AI-powered features such as meeting-minutes creation, so whether user data can be kept out of model training is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack contains no documented opt-out, training-exclusion policy, or data-use control. The llms.txt probe only gives guidance to AI crawlers about public website content, which is a different control from protecting user data, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
